title: Protein Extraction and Western Blotting Protocol
author: Shiyi Wang
materials: **Determine Protein Concentration** - Use the Pierce BSA Protein Assay Kit (Thermo Fisher).
**Prepare Protein Samples** - Mix lysates with 4x Pierce™ Reducing Sample Buffer (Thermo Scientific). - Incubate at 45°C for 45 minutes to denature proteins.
**Load Protein into Gels** - Load 7-10 μg of protein (cultured astrocyte lysates) into Bolt™ 4–12% Bis-Tris Plus gels (Thermo Scientific). - Run at 150 V for 1 hour.
**Transfer Proteins to Membrane** - Transfer proteins at 100 V to PVDF membrane (Millipore) for 1.5 hours.

**Incubate with Primary Antibodies** - Incubate overnight at 4°C with the following primary antibodies: - Anti-LRRK2 (Rabbit, 1:500; ab133474, Abcam) - GAPDH (Mouse, 1:5000; ab8245, Abcam) - β-actin (Mouse, 1:5000; A5441, Millipore Sigma)
**Incubate with Secondary Antibodies** - Incubate in HRP secondary antibodies (Thermo Fisher Scientific) for 2 hours.

steps.title: Prepare Membrane Solubilization Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a buffer containing 25 mM Tris (pH 7.4), 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM CaCl2, 1 mM MgCl2, 0.5% NP-40, and protease inhibitors.

steps.title: Wash Cultured Astrocytes
steps.instruction: Wash cultured rat astrocytes twice using ice-cold TBS containing 1 mM CaCl2 and 1 mM MgCl2.

steps.title: Extract Protein
steps.instruction: Incubate astrocytes on ice in the prepared membrane solubilization buffer for 20 minutes, applying occasional agitation.

steps.title: Collect Cell Lysates
steps.instruction: Isolate the soluble protein fraction from the cells.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4°C at high speed for 10 minutes to pellet non-solubilized material.

steps.title: Store Supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant and store it at −80°C.

steps.title: Block Membrane
steps.instruction: Block the membrane for 1 hour in 5% BSA in TBST (137 mM NaCl, 2.68 mM KCl, 24.7 mM Tris-Base, 0.1% (w/v) Tween 20).

steps.title: Wash and Image Membranes
steps.instruction: Wash the membranes in TBST and image them using a Biorad Gel Doc imaging system.

steps.title: Quantify Protein Levels
steps.instruction: Quantify the protein levels using FIJI software.
